categories.evidence: Has the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/devtools/deterministic-fuzz-coverage/src/main.rs.
categories.rationale: Optimizes deterministic fuzz coverage checking by skipping expensive llvm-cov rendering when raw profile data matches, yielding dramatic benchmark speedups like reducing 'process_message' runtime from 1h50m to 25m48s. While the speedup is substantial, this is a specialized developer tool rather than an operator-facing utility.
